시편 107:1.content: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

시편 107:2.content: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

시편 107:3.content: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

시편 107:4.content: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

시편 107:5.content: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

시편 107:6.content: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

시편 107:7.content: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

시편 107:8.content: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

시편 107:9.content: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

시편 107:10.content: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;

시편 107:11.content: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

시편 107:12.content: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

시편 107:13.content: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

시편 107:14.content: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

시편 107:15.content: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

시편 107:16.content: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

시편 107:17.content: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

시편 107:18.content: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

시편 107:19.content: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.

시편 107:20.content: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

시편 107:21.content: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

시편 107:22.content: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

시편 107:23.content: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

시편 107:24.content: These see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.

시편 107:25.content: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.

시편 107:26.content: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

시편 107:27.content: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

시편 107:28.content: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

시편 107:29.content: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

시편 107:30.content: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

시편 107:31.content: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

시편 107:32.content: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

시편 107:33.content: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

시편 107:34.content: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

시편 107:35.content: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

시편 107:36.content: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

시편 107:37.content: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

시편 107:38.content: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

시편 107:39.content: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

시편 107:40.content: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.

시편 107:41.content: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.

시편 107:42.content: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

시편 107:43.content: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the Lord.
